description: List distinct ProviderInfo values and counts for a field. Omit field to see the catalog. ownership returns the ownership labels. city requires state.

field.description: ProviderInfo field. Omit to list allowed fields. ownership returns the ownership labels.

filedate.description: Optional monthly snapshot (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM). Defaults to the latest loaded file.

state.description: Optional two-letter state. Required when field=city.
